purpose: Replace opaque full-batch R33 authority with a deterministic one-rule-at-a-time exact controller and prove prefix closure algebraically, without heuristic ranking, learning, random authority, or finite-corpus theorem authority.

r33_microstep_controller.authority: Compute exactly the first applicable frozen R33 rule. A nonterminal proposal G receives authority iff max_width(G)<=4. If the first proposal leaves W4, preserve its certificate as evidence, reject it as a successor, and test the unchanged F through existing R49H then exhaustive R47J.

theorem_obligations.T1_FIRST_RULE_CONFORMANCE: The direct one-rule extractor agrees exactly with the first history record of frozen R33 simplify whenever such a record exists.
theorem_obligations.T2_RULE_EXACTNESS: Every authorized R33 microstep is one of the already certified exact SAT-preserving R33 rules and retains reconstruction data.
theorem_obligations.T3_WIDTH_INVARIANT: Every authorized microstep persists max width <=4 by construction; non-BVE rules never increase width; any first width-breaking R33 rule is BVE.
theorem_obligations.T4_STRICT_MU_DESCENT: Every authorized nonterminal R33 microstep strictly decreases mu=(V,C,L).
theorem_obligations.T5_POLYNOMIAL_STEP_COST: Finding, constructing, and checking the first R33 microstep is polynomial in the explicit current CNF size; no exhaustive assignment search is transition authority.
theorem_obligations.T6_PREFIX_CLOSURE: Every nonempty W4-safe prefix of a frozen full R33 batch factors into a sequence of authorized R33 microsteps. Therefore every prefix state is reachable under the refined controller from the same predecessor.
theorem_obligations.T7_MINIMAL_COUNTEREXAMPLE_REDUCTION: For the refined controller U_mu, a mu-minimal reachable OPEN state cannot have a nonempty W4-safe R33 prefix. Its R33 status is therefore either FIXED_POINT or IMMEDIATE_BVE_W4_ESCAPE.
theorem_obligations.T8_OLD_U_FIREWALL: T1-T7 define and justify a refined deterministic controller U_mu. They do not retroactively prove the old full-batch guarded U.

mirror_role: Finite mirror data may falsify implementation/theorem lemmas but cannot prove them. The proof authority is source-level rule algebra plus exact replay.
